label: Windows & compositor
description: Settings for ordinary application windows, applied live to Hyprland through Bifrost's generated bifrost.lua. They never affect Bifrost's own panels (see Glass & transparency).

groups.decoration: Border & corners (colours for the mode you're in)

settings.label: Let Bifrost manage window appearance
settings.description: Off = Bifrost leaves gaps, borders, corners and blur to your own Hyprland config

settings.label: When a tiled window closes
settings.description: When closing a window leaves one tiled window on the workspace. Fill: it grows to fill the space (Hyprland's default). Keep current size: it stays where it was, floating; a window opened there takes the free space and it keeps its side and size. Keep size + manual resize: the same, but it stays floating so you can move and resize it freely; tile it again with Float/tile

settings.label: Window border
settings.description: Width of the border around application windows

settings.label: Active window border colour
settings.description: Colour of the focused application window border. Empty = theme accent.

settings.label: Inactive window border colour
settings.description: Colour of unfocused application window borders. Empty = theme default.

settings.label: Compositor rules for Bifrost surfaces
settings.description: Blur behind Bifrost panels and no compositor animation on them
